chunks: And from a letter written by him (peace be upon him and his family) to al-Ashtar an-Nakha'i, when he appointed him as the Governor of Egypt and its districts, at the time when the affairs of its commander, Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, had become precarious; it is the longest letter he wrote and the most comprehensive of good qualities.
ai.seo_question: What is the context and significance of Imam Ali's letter to Malik al-Ashtar?
ai.summary: This preamble to the 'Letter of Appointment' (Kitab al-Ashtar) establishes the historical context of Imam Ali’s governance during the turbulent transition of power in Egypt under Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr. It highlights the document's status as the most comprehensive and eloquent of his correspondence, serving as a foundational text for Shia political theory and administrative ethics.
